To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the finite element method can predict the tension state of the samples with a high accuracy.
the tension field induced by the imposed vertical displacement at the sample ends is a good predictor of the bending fatigue life of the studied steels.
finite element analysis is a useful method in the design of fatigue tests for steels.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the tension state in a sample subject to a pure bending fatigue process and with a vertical displacement imposed at the ends of the sample.
the tension field induced by pure bending fatigue process and with the possibility to predict its evolution.
a new experimental method for determining the tension state in a sample submitted to pure bending fatigue.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the numerical simulation of the tension state in bending fatigue is possible and the results are very close to those obtained experimentally.
the numerical simulation is an efficient method to predict the tension state of samples under bending fatigue.
the finite element method can be used for the simulation of the tension state in the samples subject to fatigue process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the numerical simulation based on FEM is a useful tool in the design of new equipment for testing materials under fatigue conditions.
the tension field generated by the machine is a powerful tool for the fatigue study.
a good correlation exists between the experimental data and the numerical simulations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the tension field generated by the bending fatigue process is a very good indicator of the fatigue process evolution.
the numerical simulation can be used to predict the stress state in a sample subject to fatigue process.
the tension field induced by bending can be used for the fatigue testing.
